Commentary.Commentary: So then, 252 to win and level the series. The bowlers have done well to give their team a chance. Up to the Sri Lankan batsmen to do their job. South Africa do have a good bowling attack and 250-plus scores are always tricky. What will happen? Join us in a while to find out, exciting stuff coming up...

Thisara Perera says as a bowling unit they did well. Reckons they came back really strong after it looked like South Africa will score over 300. Says that as bowlers they needed to bowl right areas and feels they did so after a point of time. States he has done his job as an all-rounder. Informs there is some extra bounce on the pitch and feels that they need to attack at the start but also keep wickets in the first 10 overs. Is confident because they have talented players in the squad and hopes they can continue their good performance. On his 150th ODI cap, Thisara Perera says that he feels honoured to have achieved this feat.

On the bowling front, Thisara Perera was the star as he picked up 3 wickets. The rest of the bowlers were decent as well, except for Vishwa Fernando who got the stick today. He managed to pick up a wicket though but in the end, the away side will be happy with the way their bowlers bounced back. Meanwhile, Thisara Perera is down for a chat by the sidelines.

South Africa could not build significant partnerships after losing de Kock. Faf du Plessis did go on to bring up his 32nd ODI fifty but saw wickets fall at the other end. At 220/4 when du Plessis and David Miller were batting, there was still 300 on the cards but once the skipper and the hard-hitting Miller fell, all hopes were lost. The tail could not wag and South Africa lost their last 6 wickets for just 31 runs. Lost their way and gave Sri Lanka a really achievable target in the game.

What a comeback this has been from the away side! At one stage, the hosts were looking at a score of 350-plus, especially when the skipper, Faf du Plessis and Quinton de Kock were batting. From 131/1 they lost their next 9 wickets and got bowled out for 251 without even batting out the entire 50 overs. Criminal from the Proteas. If one might ask where Sri Lanka came back into the game, it would have to be the wicket of De Kock. Quinton along with his opening partner, Hendricks had got off their side to a beautiful start with the former looking particularly impressive. Once Reeza departed after the opening stand of 91, Faf joined the SA keeper-batsman in the middle and De Kock kept the runs coming. He was looking set for a 100 after ages in ODIs but he top-edged one and fell for 94 to Thisara Perera.

OUT! No, Ngidi's back leg is in the air. That will be it for South  Africa, bowled out for 251! Flighted full ball on off, spinning away, Lungi stretches forward in an attempt to heave it over the leg side but misses the ball completely. Dickwella wastes no time in taking the bails off. He appeals and the square leg umpire goes upstairs. The replays roll in and it confirms that Ngidi is stumped.
Stumping appeal. It has been referred upstairs. Ngidi looks quite confident. Let's see...
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region. No run to end the over.
A slower yorker, Malinga putting all his variations on display. Tahir though is quite stubborn as he digs it out safely.
This one is a slower one around off, Ngidi tries defending but it takes the outside edge and runs down to third man for a run.

Direct hit would have been curtains for Imran Tahir. Malinga goes for another yorker but it turns out to be a full toss. Tahir pushes it to mid off and runs across for an impossible single. Akila Dananjaya misses his shy at the non-striker's end and Tahir survives. Should be aiming the base of the stumps. 250 up for South Africa.
Imran Tahir is the last man to the crease.

OUT! Malinga-special! A lethal toe-crusher, right in the line of the stumps. Too quick for Nortje. He tries to dig it out but his bat comes down late. Hit right in front of the sticks and the umpire raises his finger immediately after the lbw appeal is made. Malinga is all smiles, his second wicket this evening.
In the air... safe! A slower one, on a fuller length around middle and leg, Ngidi fails to pick and is early into his shot. Ends up chipping it over wide mid on and they cross for a run.
Flighted on off, Nortje taps it back to the bowler. Maiden Over from Akila.
Anrich has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

NOT OUT! He cannot be given out as it stuck his gloves on its way. The ball pitches and comes back into the batsman. Nortje brings out the reverse sweep but he misses. The Sri Lankan players ask the question but Aleem Dar turns it down. They go upstairs and the replays show that it flicked his right glove then the arm and then the chest. Sri Lanka lose their review but they won't mind that at this stage.

Review time! There was an appeal for LBW against Nortje but the umpire has given it as not out. Malinga takes it upstairs. Looked pretty adjacent to the naked eye. Let's see what the replays have to say.
Flighted on the stumps, Anrich defends it from within the crease.
Shorter delivery on off and middle, Nortje keeps it out.
Flighted delivery on off, Nortje blocks it.
Akila Dhananjaya back on.
Outside off on a length, driven to the cover fielder by Ngidi. 6 runs off this over, due to the midfield.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. They pick up a single.

Poor fielding by Rajitha at mid off! A slower full toss on middle, Ngidi is foxed by that ball and mistimes the ball slightly uppishly towards mid off. Rajitha there, lets the ball through his legs. Just pulls it in and saves a run for his team. But that should have been 0 runs.
Wide outside off, run down to third man for a single by Nortje.

Loud appeal for caught behind but turned down! Looks a good decision. A length ball outside off, Anrich Nortje looks to defend the ball but gets beaten. There is a noise as the ball passes the bat but it was that of the willow hitting the pad. The umpire realizes that and so does Malinga who does not review.
Wide! Goes for the yorker but sprays the ball down the leg side.
Fuller length on middle, Nortje brings his bat down to defend the ball towards the bowler.
Lasith Malinga is back on.
On the stumps, Ngidi blocks it to see off the over.
Flighted on middle and leg, Nortje pushes it towards mid on for a run.
Lands it on off and middle, Nortje blocks it off his front foot.
Flighted on off, Ngidi pushes it towards mid off for a run.
On middle and leg, Nortje tucks it towards square leg and takes a single.
Flighted delivery on off, Nortje defends it off his front foot.
Play and a miss. Length delivery outside off, Ngidi looks to cut it but misses. Successful over from Rajitha.
Good length delivery on off, Lungi hits it straight to the fielder at mid off.
Close. Length delivery around off, Ngidi looks to hit it on the off side. It hits the bottom half of his bat and then the pads. Rajitha goes up in appeal but he is not joined by anyone else.
Good length delivery on off, Ngidi blocks it.
Lungi Ngidi is the number 10 batsman.

OUT! A fantastic diving catch by the Lankan keeper! Rabada is a goner and South Africa have lost their 8th wicket. Good length delivery outside off, Rabada has a poke at it. He gets a thick outside edge on it. Niroshan Dickwella behind the stumps dives across to his left and takes a good low catch. South Africa have gone from 220/4 to 239/8. What a collapse, this!
Good length delivery on the body, Nortje tucks it towards fine leg for a single.
End of Powerplay 2. The final one begins, a maximum of 5 fielders can be kept outside the circle till the end of 50 overs now. Also, Kasun Rajitha comes back on to bowl.

Flatter and shorter outside off, Nortje goes on the back foot and outside edges his attempted cut shot. It runs down to third man where the fielder boots it out just before the line. Saves a run for his team. 9 runs and the all-important wicket of Miller from the over.
Full and floated on off, Nortje defends it by getting on the front foot.
Anrich Nortje walks in at number 9. A slip in place for him as well.

OUT! Miller is stumped! In dire straits, South Africa. Dhananjaya serves a flighted ball around off, it lands full and turns away slightly. Miller advances down the track to play the flick shot but gets beaten due to the little away spin. Dickwella is quick to take the bails off and now only the tail is left for the Proteas. This is an outstanding comeback from Sri Lanka. Restricting South Africa under 265-270 (if not lesser) will be brilliant from their point of view.
Goes back and punches a shortish ball to sweeper cover for a run.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. They pick up a single.

FOUR! Poor piece of fielding by Akila Dananjaya. Too full in length on middle, Miller attacks it and powers it over the bowler's head. Dananjaya moves across to his right from long on but over-runs and fails to stop the ball. Disappointment writ large over Malinga's face.

The line is straight again, Miller flicks it in front of square leg and jogs across to the other end. Keeps strike with himself. He will have to face maximum balls from hereon if South Africa want to get anywhere close to 300.
Full and on middle, Miller flicks it off the inner half of his bat to short fine leg.
Outside off, tapped down from the crease to point.
Wide! A length ball sliding down the leg side, Miller tries flicking but misses.
Played to the point region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Lands it on a length and outside off, Rabada stays on the back foot and pushes it back to the bowler.
On a length outside off, pushed towards mid off on the front foot by Rabada as he gets off the mark.
Kagiso Rabada walks in next, at number 8.

OUT! Lobbed up off the outside half and into the hands of point! South Africa have lost their sixth and suddenly look in some trouble. A short and quicker ball outside off, Phehlukwayo rocks back and looks to cut it, but the ball goes off the outside half and lobs towards point. Avishka takes a step or two back and takes an easy catch. Around 12 overs left now and another wicket could really mean that the Proteas could be in risk of being bowled out without finishing their quota of 50 overs. Sri Lanka fighting back hard and well in this game!
Flatter one on the pads, pushed away to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller outside off, pushed by Phehlukwayo for a single down to long off.
Flighted outside off, Miller comes down the ground and whacks the ball hard but straight to long off along the ground. Single taken.
Flatter one on middle, played with soft hands towards mid-wicket.
On the pads of the southpaw. He flicks it to the leg side for a single.
Good length delivery on off, Phehlukwayo gets off the mark with a single down towards point.
Bouncer outside off, Andile leaves it on its way to the keeper.
Length delivery outside off, Phehlukwayo dabs it down towards the slip fielder.
Andile Phehlukwayo walks in at number 7.

OUT! Thisara Perera strikes again. Good length delivery on off. It is a leg cutter from Perera at 124 kph. The ball keeps low after pitching on one of the cracks. Du Plessis is way too early into his attempted pull shot across the line and the ball hits the off pole. Huge wicket for Sri Lanka as the South African skipper was looking very good out in the middle. The visitors needed some luck and they have got that in the form of some low bounce. This is a blow for South Africa, this wicket might just restrict their final total 20 runs lesser.
Good length delivery on off, du Plessis blocks it off his back foot.
Tossed up on middle, Faf milks it towards long on and keeps the strike.
Slower through the air, Miller pushes it towards covers for a single.
On the pads, du Plessis flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Flighted on the stumps, Miller tucks it towards mid on for a single.
Flatter delivery on middle, Faf flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Flighted delivery on the pads, Miller tucks it towards mid-wicket and takes a single.
FOUR! This is really a great shot from Faf du Plessis. Thisara drops it on a length around off, du Plessis wears his skates to make room and launches it over extra cover for a boundary.
A touch short and on off, staying a bit low, du Plessis goes back and pushes it out off the bottom half of his blade to covers.
Pushes it down the ground through mid on for a run.
Straighter in line, turned on the leg side but straight to mid-wicket.

32nd ODI fifty for Faf du Plessis, fourth 50-plus score for him on the trot. The skipper has been in red-hot form. Gently taps a length ball in the gap at covers and pinches a single. He will be eyeing back-to-back hundreds here.
A leg cutter around off, du Plessis pushes at it and misses.
Thisara Perera is back into the attack.
Follows the boundary with a single. On middle, du Plessis tucks it away to the leg side for a single.
FOUR! Beautifully shot. Tossed up delivery on middle and off. Du Plessis comes down the track and pierces it beautifully between deep mid-wicket and long on for a boundary.
Flighted on middle and leg, David pushes it towards mid on and gets a single.
On the pads, Faf turns it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Flighted on off, Du Plessis strokes it to the fielder at mid on.
Flighted delivery on middle and off, Faf taps it to the right of the bowler. De Silva dives to his right and stops a single.
Single to finish the over. Length delivery outside off, du Plessis slaps it towards deep cover and keeps the strike.
Length delivery around off, Miller guides it towards third man for a single. The 200 is up for the hosts.
Length delivery on off, Miller taps it back to the bowler.
Good length delivery on middle and leg, du Plessis nudges it towards mid-wicket and gets to the other end.
Good length delivery outside off, Faf flat-bats it to mid off for another dot ball.
Good length delivery on off, the Proteas skipper defends it.
On the pads, Miller tucks it to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Flighted delivery on off, du Plessis strokes it wide of the long off fielder and looks for two. He slips on his way for the second so he sends Miller back.
Tossed up delivery on off, Miller milks it towards long off and gets a single.
Shorter on off and middle, David defends it.
On middle and leg, Miller blocks it off his front foot.
Flighted delivery on middle and off, Faf tucks it towards mid-wicket and gets a single. Du Plessis brings up his 5000th ODI runs with this single.

Drinks break! The Sri Lankans have clawed their way back into the game with wickets at decent intervals. They will hope to continue picking them up, especially those of Faf du Plessis and David Miller. If they do, they can look to restrict SA to an under-par score with not much batting to follow. As for the hosts, they will look for a partnership between the two who are at the crease now. 300 should be the minimum they should get from here. Will they? Meanwhile, Dhananjaya de Silva to bowl after the break.
Bouncer. On the body. Miller jumps and keeps it down with a straight bat.
Wide. Length delivery outside off, it is too wide for Miller to play. He leaves it alone and the umpire signals it as wide.
Shorter length delivery on the body, Faf pulls it in a very controlled fashion towards fine leg for yet another single.
On the pads, Miller flicks it towards mid-wicket and gets a run.
Length delivery outside off, du Plessis crunches it to deep cover and rotates the strike.
Good shot but only a single. Length delivery outside off, Miller hits it beautifully through covers but there is a fielder in the deep so he only gets a run.
Good length delivery on middle, Miller blocks it.
Lasith Malinga returns.
Single to end the over. Flighted on off, Miller pushes it towards long off and keeps the strike.
Loopy delivery on off, the SA skipper milks it towards covers and takes a single.
Gives this one air on middle, Faf taps it back to the bowler.
Lands it on middle and leg, du Plessis blocks it.
Tossed up delivery on off, Miller nudges it towards long off for a single.
Flighted on middle, Miller defends it off his front foot.
Length delivery on middle, David tucks it towards mid-wicket and keeps the strike with a single.
On middle and leg, Faf tucks it away towards mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Poor delivery from Fernando. Length delivery on the pads, du Plessis just helps it on its way towards fine leg for a boundary.
Length delivery outside off, David guides it towards third man and gets to the other end.
Fuller on middle, Miller flicks it wide of the fielder at deep mid-wicket and gets a couple.
Good length delivery on off and middle, Miller blocks it off his front foot.
Dot ball to end the over. On the pads, Faf tucks it to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Flighted on off, du Plessis hits it to the fielder at mid off.
Miller is off the mark. He pushes the tossed up delivery on off towards long on and gets a single.
On off stump, David pushes it towards point and looks for a quick single but du Plessis straight away says no for it.
Comes 'round the wicket and fires it on middle and off, Miller watchfully blocks it.
Flighted delivery on off, Faf tucks it towards mid-wicket and gets a single.
David Miller comes next to the crease.

OUT! What has happened there? Mulder has been bowled around his legs. A cutter landing just outside leg, 112 clicks. Mulder gets too far across but fails to put bat on ball as he goes for the flick. The ball holds its line and goes onto disturb the leg stump with the angle. A single bail falls down and Wiaan has to go. Fernando after a tough day so far finally has something to smile about. Meanwhile, Mulder who was looking ominous is bewildered as to how he got out there. Nevertheless, another break at a good timing for the visitors.
A slower one on the off stump line, Mulder defends with soft hands. The ball goes on to the pads off the inside edge. Wiaan wants to get a single but his captain says no.
Fuller on the pads, from over the wicket. Flicked away through mid-wicket for a single. The batsmen look for the second but then wisely decide against it.

FOUR! To the other side of deep cover this time! A fuller one outside off, du Plessis comes ahead, has enough width to smash this drive to the right of the fielder in the deep. Good batting while Fernando's poor day continues.
FOUR! Too wide outside off from around the wicket, du Plessis reaches out and hits it hard over the head of point for a boundary.
A length ball outside off, punched towards cover by Faf.
Vishwa Fernando comes back on.
Du Plessis works this one away through square leg for a single.
Kept out towards mid-wicket watchfully by Faf off the middle stump line.
The other one on this occasion, Mulder reads the ball and works it towards the square leg region for a single.
Turned away to mid-wicket by the SA skipper as he gets to the other end.
Outside off and bowled faster, du Plessis pushes the ball to cover this time.
Flatter one on off stump, pushed towards mid-wicket.
Akila Dananjaya comes back on.
A touch short in length on off, punched from the back foot but straight to mid off. Three dot balls to end the over.
Play and a miss! Thisara is getting some purchase from the surface. This one is served just around off and moves away a little bit. Mulder pokes inside the line and gets beaten.
Lands it on a length and wide outside off, Mulder takes his front leg forward and then shoulders arms.
On middle and leg, flicked in the gap at mid-wicket for a run.
Beaten! The greed to get cheap runs by running a short delivery down to third man. This time Faf fails to put bat on ball.

FOUR! It's raining boundaries for the Proteas. A length ball angling down the leg side, du Plessis picks it off his pads and flicks it with good timing through square leg. Oshada gives the chase but fails to pull it back in time. Seems to have hurt his right knee in the process and is off the park, receiving some treatment near the boundary line.
Kept out watchfully on the back foot. 17 runs off the over.

Edged and FOUR! Four fours on the trot. Short one just outside off, Mulder looks to punch that ball through cover without foot movement but gets an outside edge. The ball goes through where slip was present till the previous delivery! 16 off the last 4 balls. Runs are flowing here.

FOUR! Even better, this! Another one wide outside off on a length, Mulder stands tall and punches the ball into the ground. It runs past the point fielder for a boundary. Three consecutive fours, second time in this innings!
FOUR! Two in two! What timing on that one! A shorter one outside off, Wiaan stands tall and punches that one wide of point. Third man has no chance there. Classy shot from the newbie.
FOUR! That is some shot! A short of a length ball on middle, Mulder pulls it away and it is in the gap this time. The ball goes between deep mid-wicket and fine leg for a boundary.

Brilliant stop there! A short of a length ball on top of middle, du Plessis times his pull beautifully in front of square leg. Dananjaya there looks like he has over-run the ball but in the end puts his right hand down and stops the ball. Keeps it down to a single.
Length delivery outside off, Faf cuts it towards point and gets a single. He will keep the strike. End of an eventful over. 6 runs and a wicket off it.
FOUR! This should get du Plessis going. Good length delivery on off, Faf rocks onto his back foot and times his drive beautifully through covers for a boundary.
Length delivery on off, Faf pushes it to cover.
Good length delivery outside off, Faf hits it straight to the fielder at cover.
Wiaan Mulder walks in at number 5.

OUT! Caught! Rassie van der Dussen holes out and for the first time in his ODI career, he walks out for a single digit score. Bouncer from Perera, Rassie is early in his pull and gets a top edge. The ball goes very high but does not have the distance. Kasun Rajitha there runs in front and dives to take an excellent catch. Thisara Perera dragging Sri Lanka back into this game. His second wicket and he has got rid of both the well-set de Kock and the dangerous Rassie van der Dussen today.
Good length delivery outside off, du Plessis hits it towards deep cover and gets a single.
Good length delivery around off, van der Dussen hits it straight to the fielder at cover. 4 runs off it. A good one for Sri Lanka.
Wide! Misdirected bouncer down the leg side. Rassie ducks underneath. Wide signalled by the umpire.
Length delivery outside off, van der Dussen guides it wide of backward point and gets off the mark with a brace.
Full length delivery on off, Rassie starts his innings strongly and drives it to the fielder at mid off.
Back of a length delivery on the body, du Plessis pulls it to fine leg and gets to the other end.
Full length delivery on off, du Plessis drives it beautifully but straight to the cover fielder.
Good length delivery on off, Faf defends it right under his eye.
Kasun Rajitha is back on.
Fuller one at the pads, du Plessis looks to flick that ball but gets a leading edge towards third man for a single.
Another short ball outside off, pushed to the cover region by the SA skipper.
Shorter one outside off, punched towards cover.
Rassie van der Dussen walks in at number 4.

OUT! Another one missed! De Kock is really distraught as he has to walk away. A length ball on the hips, Quinton looks to flick it away but the ball takes the top edge and flies straight in the air. Stays there for a long time but Dickwella settles under it and takes an easy catch. Thisara Perera is happy but not the batsman. De Kock has not got an ODI hundred since 2017. He has thrown it away yet again. He knew he was gone once the ball went in the air and looks down at the ground in disgust. There was a hundred for the taking there, maybe even a double but unfortunately it's not to be. End of an incredible innings, there was so much more there for the taking. Such a disappointment!
Length ball outside off, pushed towards extra cover.
Short of a length, de Kock stands tall and defends the ball. It rolls back towards the keeper.
Finishes the over with a single. Flighted delivery on off, Quinton pushes it wide of the cover fielder and keeps the strike. An expensive one for Sri Lanka, 15 runs off the over.
On the pads, de Kock flicks it to the fielder on the leg side.
FOUR! He was just taking a breather there. Short again from de Silva and this time de Kock pulls it in a controlled manner through mid-wicket for a boundary.
This time Quinton relaxes and defends this tossed up delivery.
SIX! This is even better. Short again, this time de Kock goes leg side. He gets on his back foot and sends the ball sailing over the mid-wicket fence with his pull shot for a maximum.
FOUR! Short, wide and punished. Dhananjaya lands it short outside off, De Kock is in superb touch, he gets on his back foot and slaps it through covers.
Double bowling change now. Dhananjaya de Silva is back into the attack.
Length delivery on off, Faf guides it towards short third man and looks for a quick single but decide otherwise.

In the air...but safe. Good length delivery on off. The ball holds onto the pitch and comes to Faf. He looks to drive and he does so uppishly. The fielder at short cover dives to his left but cannot get there. The batsmen get two runs as it goes wide of long off.
On the pads again, Quinton flicks it towards deep square leg and looks for two. He sees the fielder is quick in his collection and hence decides to stay with only a single.
Length delivery this time on the thigh pad, de Kock pulls it but finds the fielder at short fine leg.
Once again length delivery on off stump line, Quinton defends it with soft hands.
Starts with a good length delivery on off stump. De Kock carefully defends it off his front foot.
Thisara Perera is introduced into the attack.
Shorter one on top of off stump, pushed back to the bowler on the back foot.
Good straighter one! A flatter ball outside off, Faf looks to drive but is foxed by that ball which holds its line.
Flighted on middle, du Plessis comes ahead and paddles that one fine on the leg side. Finds a couple of runs.
Flatter one outside off, pushed back to long off for a single.
FOUR! Two in two, off the back foot now! A short one outside off, it was wide. De Kock reaches out and smashes it past the cover fielder again. Finds the rope again.

FOUR! How well was that ball timed! A decent ball outside off with some flight, de Kock is just in such good form as he gets into position and drives the ball through the covers. Finds the gap to the left of deep cover.
Good ball! Well-directed short one on middle, du Plessis looks to pull it away through square leg but is early into the shot and misses the ball.
Turned away by QdK for a single towards square leg. Easily done by the lefty, he is looking really at ease out in the middle.
On a length and bowled at the thigh pad, pushed towards mid on.

FOUR! It's back above 6! This time the short ball is dispatched. A short ball on the ribs of Quinton, he swivels and pulls it away with ease to the deep backward square leg boundary. The 100 comes up for the hosts.
Shorter on middle, Quinton ducks under the ball and lets it go. The run rate has come down below 6.
On a length outside off, de Kock pushes the ball on the front foot towards cover. He does not get the placement or the best timing there.

Drinks break! The hosts have gotten off to a really good start here, scoring at more than run-a-ball. Quinton de Kock has helped himself to a quick half-ton and his opening partner, Reeza Hendricks too got a good start. He just threw it away where he could have made it big. Faf du Plessis has joined the SA keeper-bat in the middle and will look to continue the good work. So far, Sri Lanka have looked listless in the field and need to pull up their socks really quickly.
Shorter one outside off, played away through point for a single. End of a decent over from Dananjaya.
Flicked away wide of mid-wicket for a couple of runs. Malinga out there, misfielded slightly allowing for the second run to be completed easily.
Flatter one on the pads, worked away by du Plessis for a single to deep mid-wicket. The skipper is off the mark.
Flatter one outside off, kept out on the front foot towards the bowler by Faf.
With air and bowled on the middle stump line, Faf allows the ball to come to him as he keeps it out.
Flighted outside off, de Kock comes ahead and pushes it wide of cover for a single.
Shorter outside off, pushed to cover off the back foot. End of a successful over from the SL skipper, 4 runs and a wicket off it.
Another shorter one outside off, Faf thinks about pulling it but holds himself back from playing the ball as he draws out right at the end.
Another shorter one outside off this time, du Plessis looks to pull but gets an inside edge onto the chest. Looks hurt, moves away and takes some time to compose himself.
Wide! Short ball but sprayed down the leg side now. Left alone by the batsman but it is wided by the umpire.
Faf du Plessis walks in at number 3.

OUT! Taken! That is the first one down! The captain brings himself back and breaks the 91-run stand. A bouncer on middle, Hendricks looks to hook the ball away but does not control the ball well. It goes off the top edge and flies to long leg. Akila Dananjaya there makes no mistake. Sri Lanka finally have the breakthrough, a much-needed one for them. They will look for a couple more quickly now.
Punched off the back foot once more, only a single this time.
On a length outside off, pushed away hard off the back foot to the left of deep cover. 2 runs picked up till the ball comes back.
Lasith Malinga comes back on now.
Flatter outside off, pushed to deep cover for a single by southpaw.
Flatter on middle, turned away to deep mid-wicket for a run by the right-hander.
Flatter one outside off, keeps a tad low. Reeza gets low in time to push the ball towards mid-wicket.
Lots of air on this ball on the middle stump line, pushed back to long on for a run.
Flatter on the middle stump line, worked away to square leg for a single by RH.
Some flight and turn on this one landing outside off, Hendricks dead-bats it.
Yes, he does. A length ball outside off, pushed wide of deep cover but the fielder there does well to keep it down to a single.
On a length outside off, pushed back to the bowler by Reeza. 5 dots off the over so far, can Kasun end it well?
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Good ball! Rajitha hits the deck hard. The ball is on a length outside off, Hendricks looks to cut but extra bounce beats the bat.
Short outside off, RH looks to punch it off the back foot but gets it off the inside half. The ball goes to extra cover.
On a length just outside off, kept out towards cover.
Pushed back to long on for a run to end the over. 7 runs off it in the end.
FOUR! Nice shot! Went really short this time, Hendricks rocks back and punches the ball through the covers for a boundary.
Shorter one, Quinton rocks back and cuts the ball to deep cover for a single.
Fuller one on the pads, worked away for a single through square leg.
Flighted outside off, really full. Reeza looks to drive but fails to get any timing on that shot.
Flatter one on the off stump, pushed towards mid-wicket.
Fuller one outside off, pushed with nice timing but finds the mid off fielder this time.
A bumper on the leg stump region, de Kock stands tall and gets on his toes to fend the ball onto the ground.
Pushed through the covers for a single by RH.
On a length outside off, slight away movement. Hendricks looks to drive without much foot movement, standing tall, but fails to put bat on ball due to the away swing.
Short of a length outside off, defended off the back foot towards the bowler.
Short of a length on off stump line, Hendricks looks to flick that ball but fails to put bat on ball. It goes off the thigh pad and towards slip.
Powerplay 2 begins. A maximum of 4 fielders can be kept outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over now.
Fuller one on the pads, worked away to deep mid-wicket for a single. RH keeps strike. 75 runs off the first 10 overs for the hosts!
Shorter one outside off, lots of bounce on that ball. Hendricks stands tall and cuts the ball but finds backward point.
Shorter and fired in on middle, the SA keeper-bat pulls the ball towards deep mid-wicket and picks up a single.
Flatter and quicker on the pads, QdK sweeps the ball but finds short fine leg.
Slightly slower through the air and on off stump. Defended on the front foot by de Kock.
Flatter one on middle, Hendricks pushes the ball towards the right of mid-wicket. Gets off strike.
Akila Dananjaya to bowl the last over of the Powerplay 1.

FOUR! Brings up his fifty in style! 20th ODI 50 for Quinton de Kock. A length ball on the pads, the southpaw turns it past short fine leg and to the fence. Too easy it has been so far. 13 runs off this over and South Africa looking really strong here.
FOUR! Slower ball again and this time really full on the middle stump line. De Kock waits and drives it back past the bowler, as straight as a bullet. Finds the rope. On 49 now!
On a length and off stump line, pushes it back towards mid off. Not the best timing there.
Wide! Rajitha loses his radar as he looks to bowl a slower ball. Sprays it waywardly outside off.
Corrects the line and gets the ball on top of off stump, de Kock pushes the ball back to the bowler on his back foot.
FOUR! Fluent shot from de Kock once more! On a fuller length outside off, the southpaw leans into the drive and gets it past mid off to his right for a boundary. This surface is an absolute belter!
On a length outside off, Quinton de Kock comes ahead and pushes the ball towards mid on. The ball pinged off the bat there.
Short and wide outside off, QdK cuts the ball wide of point for a single down to third man.
On a length outside off, defended under his nose by Quinton. The ball goes towards Dickwella.

Slightly in the air but safe! A slower ball outside off, de Kock is early into the drive. The ball goes uppishly but wide of a diving short cover. The mid off fielder gives chase and stops the ball for two runs.
FOUR! De Kock is looking in impeccable form here! A fuller one on the middle stump line, Quinton flicks it away really well through mid-wicket for a boundary.
On the middle stump line, Hendricks turns it down towards fine leg for a single.
On a length well outside off from Vishwa, left alone by the batsman.

FOUR! 50 up for the hosts and of the partnership as well! This has been a rollicking start for the hosts. A length ball on off stump line and coming in a bit, de Kock times it really well and beats the deep square leg fielder to his right.
Cut him in half! On a length outside off, de Kock comes ahead and tries to push it back down the ground but the ball moves inward and he is beaten.
On a length outside off, de Kock comes ahead and defends it towards mid off.

Short of a length and coming into the batsman but bowled on the middle stump line. RH looks to pull but gets it off the inner half of the bat. The ball rolls towards square leg and the batsmen pick up a run.
FOUR! Shot of the day so far for me! Slightly fuller outside off, Reeza holds his stance as he drives this beautifully to the left of mid off. Exquisite timing!
Starts off with a length ball outside off, patted back from the crease by Hendricks.
Kasun Rajitha into the attack.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat. Better over from Vishwa, 5 off it in the end.
Play and a miss! A length ball outside off and coming into the left-hander, de Kock looks to drive it through cover but the inswing makes him miss the ball as it goes past the inside edge.
Short and wide outside off, de Kock looks to cut off the back foot but fails to put bat on ball.
A length ball outside off, QdK once again times it well but Vishwa puts a hand to stop the ball that was coming to his right. Saved a certain boundary there.
Lucky to get away with that one, Vishwa. Fuller and wide outside off, Quinton gets it really well on his bat but finds the fielder at cover.
WIDE! Loses his radar and bowls this one well wide outside off.

FOUR! He is welcomed back in the same way he was sent away on the last ball of his previous over. Fernando goes for a yorker but bowls it outside off. De Kock comes ahead, takes it on the full and times it beautifully past mid on for a boundary. Seventh four for Quinton inside the sixth over.
Vishwa Fernando is back on now, after just one over of spin.
FOUR! Shot! Made a solid sound off the bat. On a length outside off, Hendricks stands tall and punches it wide of cover for a boundary. Expensive 3rd over from Lasith as he goes for 10 runs.
Slower-ball yorker at 113 kph! Almost foxed Hendricks there with the lack of pace. Reeza though reacts just in time to keep the ball out.
Short of a length on the hips, Hendricks works it away through square leg for a couple of runs.
Outside off on a length, pushed towards cover by the right-hander.
FOUR! Easy pickings for Hendricks. Malinga sprays the ball on the pads and Reeza just glances it really fine for a boundary. The first boundary for RH.
Length ball on middle, pushed towards mid on.

FOUR! Just wide of mid on! A flatter one on the off stump line, Quinton de Kock comes down the track and lifts the ball over mid on for a boundary. He got a little too close to the ball there and did not get the elevation he wanted on that. But there was enough power to take it wide of the fielder. 8 runs off the over! De Kock has raced past 25.
QdK has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
FOUR! De Kock has had a look and decides enough is enough. Comes down the ground to this flighted ball outside off. Quinton lifts it over cover and the ball goes on a couple of bounces into the rope.
Fuller and flatter outside off, pushed to cover once more.
A shorter one outside off now, Quinton stands tall and punches the ball to cover.
Flatter one on middle, de Kock defends the ball towards mid-wicket.
Only one over for Vishwa. Some spin as Dhananjaya de Silva comes on to bowl now.
Outside off and a shorter length than usual, Hendricks pats the ball towards point. 2 runs again off Malinga's over.
The line is a little straighter this time, on the middle stump. QdK uses his wrists to pick up a single towards square leg.
Goes for another yorker now, de Kock comes ahead and pushes that ball to cover after taking it on the full.
On a length this time outside the off stump, pushed back down the ground.
Around the wicket, a yorker to de Kock into the blockhole. The batsman digs the ball out.

Lucky! A length ball on middle and slightly shaping away, Hendricks looks to defend with a straight bat but gets the outside edge and the ball runs wide of slip for a single down to third man. Lucky for the batsman that he got some bat on that, would have been plumb in front if he had not.

FOUR! That one dot ball was an aberration. A fuller one outside off and Quinton de Kock smashes his drive past the right of mid off and all the way to the rope. 16 runs off the second over of the innings. QdK up and away!
Length ball outside off, pushed back towards the bowler by the southpaw.

FOUR! A hat-trick of boundaries for de Kock. He is at it again! Was in superb touch in the last game and has started brilliantly here. Another one full and wide outside off, the SA wicket-keeper batsman has found the gap through cover-point despite an extra fielder being brought there.

FOUR! Two in two and this was even more classy. A tad fuller than the previous ball, de Kock leans into the drive and puts it in the gap between point and cover. No stopping those once it beats the infield.
FOUR! The first boundary of the day! A length ball and well outside off, Quinton de Kock reaches out and smashes it wide of point. Third man cannot come around in time to stop the ball.
Fuller in length straightaway, looking for some movement. De Kock though comes ahead and drives the ball to point before it could shape away.
Vishwa Fernando has the other new ball.
Good end to the over from Malinga! Bowls this on a length and just outside off, RH plays inside the line and gets beaten. Could have easily edged that to slip.
Well outside off, no shot offered by the batsman.
Short of a length outside off, looks like that one stuck in the surface and went slower than expected to the batsman. Hendricks defends it calmly onto the surface though.
Outside off on a length, pushed to the covers.
On the money to the right-hander, landing on a length in the middle stump line. Some away movement there but Reeza covers the line of the ball and defends it.

Around the wicket to begin, a good length ball from Malinga and it comes in with the angle after landing outside off. A hint of swing there but de Kock does well to dab it wide of slip for a single. Nice ball from Lasith though!

The Sri Lankan fielders are taking their positions now. Quinton de Kock and Reeza Hendricks will open for the hosts. Lasith Malinga with the first new ball in hand. A slip in place, all in readiness! Let's play...
Both the teams are walking out to the middle along with the mascots. They line up for both countries' national anthems.

TOSS - Sri Lanka win the toss and elect to bowl first. The visitors have two changes, Kasun Rajitha and Avishka Fernando come in for Lakshan Sandakan and Upul Tharanga. The hosts on the other hand, have a solitary change which sees Andile Phehlukwayo come in place of Dwaine Pretorius.

After sweeping aside the visitors in the first ODI, South Africa welcome the Lankans to the SuperSport Park in Centurion. The Proteas looked a completely different unit from the ones that were beaten in the red-ball format. Surely, they would not be looking to change much and there is no reason for them to either. Sri Lanka on the other hand, will have to look to do something about their lower middle order which just seems invisible. They will also need some changes in their bowling, that was too easily dealt with by the hosts in the first game. Can Lasith Malinga and team do things differently and bring the series back to level? On a good surface and in a day-night game, the toss will surely matter. Stay tuned for it!
